title: Cardinality of the edge-occurrence space
statement: Let $s$ be a state of the contraction process, consisting of a multigraph $G$ together with a cut of $G$, and let its sample space of edge occurrences be the finite set of pairs (edge, occurrence index) drawn from the edge multiset of $G$. Then this sample space has cardinality equal to the edge count of $G$, that is, the number of edges of $G$ counted with multiplicity.
hypotheses_covered: s is a state (a multigraph G with a cut C)
replaced: The occurrence sample space of a state has cardinality $s.G.\mathrm{edgeCount}$.
